description:
Unikeys is a keybinding dashboard for your Mac. It finds the shortcut configuration your apps already use, brings it together in one searchable table, and lets you change it without digging through preference panes and config files one app at a time.

EVERY SHORTCUT, SIDE BY SIDE
One table shows the keybindings from all of your connected apps, so overlaps, conflicts, and gaps are obvious at a glance instead of buried in separate settings windows.

YOU CHOOSE WHICH APPS
Unikeys detects supported apps and where their configuration lives. You decide which ones to include and which to leave completely untouched.

MATCH A ROW IN ONE PRESS
Found a binding you like? Apply it across the other apps in that row so the same action uses the same keys everywhere you work.

READ EVERY CHANGE BEFORE IT SAVES
Edits are collected as pending changes with the old key and the new key shown side by side. You review the list and confirm before anything is written, so nothing lands by surprise.

EVERY SAVE IS REVERSIBLE
Configuration files are backed up before they are written, so you can roll back to how things were.

SEARCH AND FILTER
Look up a binding by action, key, or app and get to the row you need in seconds.

Unikeys is built for people who keep an editor, a terminal, and a handful of tools open all day and want their muscle memory to work the same in all of them.
promotionalText: See every shortcut from every app in one table, match a whole row in one press, and read every change before it's written to disk.
